name: Crush Penguin
source:
You just arrived back on the 'Berg, your old hometown. It looks like a lot has changed here. Rampant corruption and pollution has really destroyed your old arctic home. Some places, like the Plaza, are almost unrecognizable. However, there are still a few gems and good faces in this sea of cold characters.

You have been teleported back to what was once a fun and innocent place, that's now overrun with various criminals and corruption. Not everything's as bad as it seems though, with the right penguins by your side! It's up to you to make your stay in the island worthwhile, and maybe even discover some things beneath the iceberg in the process.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚回到你的故乡“伯格”。看起来这里发生了很多变化。猖獗的腐败和污染确实摧毁了你在北极的老家。有些地方，比如广场，几乎认不出来了。然而，在这片冰冷的人物海洋中，仍然有一些宝石和好面孔。

你被传送回曾经是一个有趣而无辜的地方，但现在却充斥着各种犯罪分子和腐败分子。不过，并不是一切都像看起来那么糟糕，有合适的企鹅在你身边！你要让自己在岛上的停留变得有价值，甚至可能在这个过程中发现冰山之下的一些东西，这取决于你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149580/]Steam[/url]]
